d:
This track celebrates the richness of Punjabi culture and honors the pioneers who have played a pivotal role in shaping its vibrant identity and traditions. It pays tribute to the beauty of the Punjabi spirit while highlighting the contributions that have defined the community and its essence. Throughout the song, I proudly flex my heritage, embracing the pride of being Punjabi with every verse.

Written & Performed By: Ghaint Jxtt
